text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy STARTED for service=runtime-api env=prod-usw2 commit=ab12f9d tag=release/v2.4.1 change_window=2026-03-20T02:00Z/04:00Z canary_pct=5. Running smoke checks and probe traffic. Trigger: CI pipeline #4821.

alex: ack — watching metrics, will ping if anything odd. tagging @mira for latency. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Smoke checks: PASS (startup, basic infer, auth). KV cache warmup=80%. Metrics snapshot: p50=42ms p95=210ms error_rate=0.12%.

mira: saw a small p95 blip to ~320ms at ~120s, traces point to a single GPU pod with slightly higher GC. Not seeing errors.

samir: incrementing traffic to 10% now per rollout policy.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic updated -> 10%. Rolling window monitoring for 15m.

tyler: hold — DB migration job scheduled in 8m that toggles feature_flag=infer_v2. Need to ensure flag is off before we push further. Please pause until migration completes.
alex: pausing rollout now. pinning this canary to commit ab12f9d (tag=release/v2.4.1-canary-paused). @deploy-bot please pause traffic adjustments.
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10% as requested. Autoscale and roll policy suspended. Recording note: hold requested by tyler for DB migration.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled migration job start in 6m (runbook #infra/pg-migrations).

mira: good call. I'll keep an eye on the paused pods and FLB. No error spikes while paused.

(8 minutes later)
oncall-bot: Migration job COMPLETED successfully. Diff check: no schema drift, downtime=0s.

tyler: migration looks clean. feature_flag=infer_v2 remains OFF. Okay to resume.
alex: resuming canary — moving to 25% per policy and keeping extended window.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic updated -> 25%. Running extended checks: perf baselines, error budgets, user-facing latency.

mira: p50 stable at 45ms, p95 trending 220–260ms across pods. No new error classes. Sampling N=500 requests looks fine.
samir: rolling to 50% next step in 10m if no regressions.

(10 minutes later)
deploy-bot: Extended checks OK. Cannery step to 50% completed. Health signals: p50=44ms p95=230ms error_rate=0.13% ambient.
jess: putting a soft pin on deploy: release/v2.4.1 -> commit ab12f9d. Update release notes link: https://go.redwood/release/v2.4.1/notes (minor runtime fixes + kv cache warmup).

ale x: (typo) alex: thanks jess. Planning promotion? We have fallback tag release/v2.4.0 ready.

mira: no anomalies in traces, tail latencies look stable. from QE: smoke-eval prompt sets pass at 0.98 quality threshold.
deploy-bot: Canary promotion window open. Promotion target: 100% steady rollout with gradual ramp (50->100 over 5m).
samir: promoting to 100% now. If anything bad, auto-rollback to release/v2.4.0 will trigger.
deploy-bot: PROMOTION STARTED -> ramping 50% -> 100%. Observability hooks engaged.

(3 minutes later)
deploy-bot: PROMOTION COMPLETE — service=runtime-api env=prod-usw2 now serving tag=release/v2.4.1 at 100%. Final health: p50=43ms p95=225ms error_rate=0.11%.
jess: release pinned in registry and changelog updated. Notifying docs + support.
tyler: thanks everyone — keeping a watch for 30m, but looks good.

oncall-bot: Post-deploy checklist started (30m watch). Automated rollback condition thresholds: error_rate >0.5% OR p95 > 500ms sustained 5m.

alex: great job. Closing thread. :tada:
